topic: A neighbor wants to install a fence
text: I just found out that my neighbor is planning to put up a fence. I mean, I get it, privacy and all, but it feels like this could change things between us. I’ve lived here for years, and we’ve always had an open line of communication, a sort of unspoken agreement about our shared space. I’m not sure how to approach this. Do I just let it happen, or do I try to talk to them? What if they’ve already made up their mind? I guess I’ll need to gather my thoughts and maybe stop by their place this evening. Just hoping we can work this out without things getting awkward.
